label: DRY RUN, development traces. Do ported published arms collapse onto one behaviour in live2, and what is the true cardinality of the published field.
question: mooncake and b7-edf-feasibility are byte-identical in 28 of 28 leaderboard cells; are they one mechanism under two names

verdict.mooncake_vs_b7: GENUINELY DISTINCT. Their ACTION SEQUENCES differ at 8 devices (3c0c7ef4d6ea5464 against 46bc6652a79d5b04) AND at 16 devices (e7e87de8f49f6a18 against 04d3e84cd47d9675). They converge in OUTCOME, not in behaviour.
verdict.why_they_converge: their only differences are Action.order (MOONCAKE-REUSE-FIRST against EDF) and session actions (mooncake emits 9 KEEP_GPU_WARM, b7 emits none). Action.order is NEVER READ by live2/coordinator.py, so that difference cannot reach a decision, and desired_tier did not bite in these cells.
verdict.the_wrapper_is_not_the_cause: the D130 wrappers override nothing but the name; the collapse pressure comes from live2 ignoring Action.order, not from the port.

action_order_is_dead.finding: live2/coordinator.py contains ZERO references to the action order field; the two `.order` hits are `self.st.order`, a different object
action_order_is_dead.consequence: any two adapted arms whose scheduling discipline is expressed only through Action.order are indistinguishable in live2 by construction
action_order_is_dead.affected_claim: the published fields apparent diversity is partly carried by a field the harness does not read

cardinality.cell: seed 4, 8 devices, 300 s, 50:50, mode A, 20 arms including llf
cardinality.note: excluding the ignored order field, ekya and inar-vl collapse onto one behaviour, so the twelve in-card-scope arms supply ELEVEN independent behaviours at this cell, not twelve.

regime_dependence.finding: the collapses are REGIME DEPENDENT, not structural
regime_dependence.evidence: ekya and videostorm are action-identical at 8 devices and DIVERGE at 16 devices (1a67cac3ac552f95 against 22842b3b69998d21, 18 of 21 against 19 of 21 robots)
regime_dependence.implication: a cardinality measured at one size does not carry to another; the paper should state the size it was measured at

_provenance.script: scratchpad harness wrapping each arm decide() to hash its canonical action sequence; no repo code changed
_provenance.n: seed 4; 8 devices over 20 arms; 16 devices over 6 arms; 300 s
